summary: Uniti Group Inc. filed an 8-K to announce the pricing of $1,140.71 million aggregate principal amount of secured fiber network revenue term notes by its subsidiary Kinetic ABS Issuer LLC. The offering comprises three tranches: $805.21M 5.834% Class A-2, $134.2M 6.224% Class B, and $201.3M 7.536% Class C notes, with a weighted average coupon of ~6.180% and an anticipated repayment date in June 2033. The notes are secured by residential fiber network assets and customer agreements across ten states. The offering is exempt from registration under Rule 144A and Regulation S, expected to close on July 15, 2026. This is a routine debt securitization financing, not a special situation.
